text:
maya: re: last week's outage, quick thread to lock down follow-up ownership and cadence. propose: 48h triage, 14d remediation sprint, 30d validation. thoughts? :clock1:

chen: +1 to fixed windows. add: a short owner rotation list so followups don't stall. two-week followup IC sounds good.

oliver: can we require a single-line "next-step" in the postmortem root so reviewers see urgent actions immediately? e.g., Next-step: deploy rollback + add retry.

maya: yes. template idea: Root summary (1 line), Next-step (1 line), Owner, Due date, Recurrence tag {none,suspect,confirmed}. Keep it tiny so people fill it.

chen: also suggest a weekly 30-min remediation sync (15m updates) for all open followups >7 days. helps unblock cross-team deps.

oliver: automation: when recurrence-confirmed -> create longform RCA ticket and assign senior owner; when suspect -> assign followup IC and auto-remind every 3 days until resolved.

ops-bot: created followup task https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-3002 and scheduled reminder in 72h. :white_check_mark:

maya: action items: chen to publish rotation list (due EOD), oliver to add one-line next-step field to template (due 24h), I'll schedule the weekly remediation sync (start next Tue). anyone object?

chen: no objections.

oliver: will update template and link it to RI-3002.

ops-bot: reminder set: followup owners check-in in 72h (thread 1745550000).

maya: closing thread, will attach final template to the postmortem and ping the rotation announcement. thanks!
